reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law, as_of_treatment is 2026-06-30, varies_by_point is false, and the scope_note matches the page.

residual_risks: A full citator/CourtListener audit would be needed to resolve the proposed negative-event hits conclusively.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Surface the distinction between confirmed treatment and proposed audit hits.
